content_data.project_title: Regional Fan Engagement & Digital Experience Transformation Initiative
content_data.project_description: Comprehensive marketing program to enhance fan engagement across digital platforms and drive season ticket renewals through personalized content strategies and community-building initiatives.
content_data.timeline: 12 months with Phase 1 (months 1-4) focusing on research and strategy, Phase 2 (months 5-9) on implementation, and Phase 3 (months 10-12) on optimization
objectives: Expand digital community engagement across social platforms and mobile applications
Strengthen brand positioning against regional competitors through authentic storytelling
Increase season ticket holder retention by building deeper emotional connections with regional fan base
deliverables: Social media engagement playbook with community management guidelines
Email marketing automation workflows for six fan segments
Performance dashboard with real-time campaign tracking capabilities
Multi-channel content calendar with 150+ pieces of original creative assets
content_data.risk_mitigation: Key risks include platform algorithm changes affecting organic reach, potential budget constraints from ownership, and creative agency capacity limitations. Mitigation strategies include diversifying content distribution across owned channels, building modular campaign components that allow budget flexibility, establishing backup creative resources, and implementing agile sprint methodologies for rapid pivoting based on performance data.
